description.en: The name of the execution plan.

description.zh:
资源类型。
- Standard：标准型。
- Dedicated：专属型，需开通白名单使用。
- Economic：经济型，需开通白名单使用。
description.en:
The resource type.

- Standard: Standard.

- Dedicated: Dedicated. This type is available only to users in the whitelist.

- Economic: Economy. This type is available only to users in the whitelist.

description.zh: 执行计划期望的资源规模。如果ResourceType是VcpuCapacity的话，该字段表示执行计划希望保有10000vCPU。
description.en: The desired size of the resource for the execution plan. For example, if you set ResourceType to VcpuCapacity, this parameter specifies the number of vCPUs that you want to maintain for the execution plan.

description.zh:
算力等级，仅在资源类型为经济型时有效。支持以下类型：
- General：通用型。
- Performance：性能型。

默认值：General
description.en:
The computing power level. This parameter is valid only when you set AllocationSpec to Economic. The following types are supported:

- General: General-purpose.

- Performance: Compute-optimized.

Default value: General
The pre-execution script. The script must be Base64-encoded.

description.zh: 执行计划运行环境的地域资源配置列表。
description.en: A list of regional resource configurations for the runtime environment of the execution plan.

description.zh: 执行计划在该地域可用的安全组列表。安全组支持0～5个。
description.en: A list of security groups that are available for the execution plan in the region. You can specify 0 to 5 security groups.

description.zh: 交换机ID列表，您可以通过[DescribeSecurityGroups接口](https://api.aliyun.com/document/Ecs/2014-05-26/DescribeSecurityGroups)查询可用交换机信息。
description.en: A list of security group IDs. You can call the [DescribeSecurityGroups](https://api.aliyun.com/document/Ecs/2014-05-26/DescribeSecurityGroups) operation to query information about available security groups.

description.zh: 执行计划在该地域可用的交换机列表。交换机支持0～5个。
description.en: A list of vSwitches that are available for the execution plan in the region. You can specify 0 to 5 vSwitches.

description.zh:
执行目标资源类型：vCPU容量或者执行节点数。取值范围如下：

- VCpuCapacity：vCPU容量

- ExecutorCapacity：执行节点数
description.en:
The type of resource for the execution target. The value can be the vCPU capacity or the number of executor nodes. Valid values:

- VCpuCapacity: vCPU capacity

- ExecutorCapacity: number of executor nodes

description.zh: 执行计划运行环境的资源配置列表。资源配置支持 1 ～ 10个。
description.en: A list of resource configurations for the runtime environment of the execution plan. You can specify 1 to 10 resource configurations.
The number of vCPUs for the runtime environment.

description.zh: 运行环境的内存大小。单位是GiB。
description.en: The memory size of the runtime environment. Unit: GiB.
The script to run the job. The script must be Base64-encoded.

descriptions.zh: **请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解E-HPC Instnat产品的收费方式和[价格](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/e-hpc/e-hpc-instant/product-overview/billing-overview?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-57664.d_0_2_0.5fdd28422y6UvO)。**
descriptions.en: **Before you call this operation, ensure that you understand the billing methods and **[**pricing**](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/e-hpc/e-hpc-instant/product-overview/billing-overview?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-57664.d_0_2_0.5fdd28422y6UvO)** of E-HPC Instant.**
